Alger, 6 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — La B: Algiers, August 6, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Bank of Algeria has published a regulation governing the operation of the National Payments Committee (CNP), tasked with developing the national strategy for the development of scriptural payment methods.
Institution d'un cadre réglementaire pou: Establishment of a regulatory framework for scriptural payments
ALGER — Le Gouverneur de la Banque d'Alg: ALGIERS — The Governor of the Bank of Algeria has promulgated Regulation No. 26-01 of 14 Dhou El Hidja 1447 (May 31, 2026) setting out the organization and operation of the National Payments Committee (CNP). This text is based on Articles 163 to 165 of the amended Monetary and Banking Law No. 23-09 of 3 Dhou El Hidja 1444 (June 21, 2023).
Le CNP a pour mission principale l'élabo: The primary mission of the CNP is to draft the national strategy project for the development of scriptural payment methods. Its meetings will be held at the headquarters of the Bank of Algeria, with a dedicated permanent secretariat headed by a permanent secretary appointed by the Governor.
Composition et missions du secrétariat p: Composition and missions of the permanent secretariat
Le règlement précise que le secrétariat: The regulation specifies that the permanent secretariat of the CNP is responsible for several key missions:
la préparation des dossiers thématiques: preparing thematic files for committee meetings;
l'élaboration des études préliminaires r: drawing up the required preliminary studies;
l'échange d’informations avec les membre: exchanging information with CNP members and working groups;
la diffusion des résolutions adoptées au: disseminating adopted resolutions to relevant stakeholders;
Ces dispositions s'inscrivent dans le ca: These provisions are part of ongoing banking and monetary reforms, validated by the Monetary and Banking Council during its session on May 31, 2026.
La Banque d'Algérie instaure un Comité n: The Bank of Algeria is establishing a National Payments Committee (CNP) via Regulation No. 26-01 of May 31, 2026.
Le CNP a pour mission l'élaboration de l: The mission of the CNP is to draft the national strategy for scriptural payments.
Le comité est présidé par le Gouverneur: The committee is chaired by the Governor of the Bank of Algeria or their representative among the deputy governors.
Le CNP comprend des représentants des mi: The CNP includes representatives from the Ministries of Finance, Justice, Commerce, Post and Telecommunications, Digitization, Knowledge Economy, Start-ups and Micro-enterprises (general directors).
Deux représentants de la Banque d'Algéri: Two representatives from the Bank of Algeria, the general director of Algérie Poste, as well as representatives from internal security, the national gendarmerie, national security, the professional banking association, the interbank electronic payment body, and the interbank electronic payment center are also members.
Le secrétariat permanent du CNP, dirigé: The permanent secretariat of the CNP, headed by a secretary appointed by the Governor, is responsible for preparing meetings, studies, and disseminating resolutions.
Le règlement s'appuie sur la loi monétai: The regulation is based on the amended Monetary and Banking Law No. 23-09 of June 21, 2023.
